ownerQuote: 不要这样子，你需要把整个东西给收敛好了，然后尽快交付出可以达到合格层次，可以达到售卖标准的产品。你看下怎么样搞个合适的这个路径去把这个东西一步步推进完。
correction: Convergence means completing the original sellable user outcome. A speaker-only issue is one work item; rejecting a candidate does not stop product delivery. Avoid blind trials without freezing all engineering work.
userOutcome: Record a real Chinese/English meeting with the card; see incremental text while receiving; finish or import offline audio; obtain reliable speaker-attributed text and evidence-linked minutes; replay, correct, save, reopen and export on the intended Windows/Android path.

architecture.capture: One durable original audio/session timeline and recoverable transfer; never replace or consume unsafely acknowledged source audio.
architecture.live: Existing bounded local incremental ASR as revisable draft; local automatic Chinese/English route must replace the fixed-Chinese research-only assumption before bilingual qualification.
architecture.closed: One finalization stage over the complete original timeline, reusing valid bound ASR results rather than blindly retranscribing the entire meeting. Whole-recording speaker identity reconciliation and alignment may revise draft identities.
architecture.text: Current Qwen1.7 is a candidate baseline, not a guaranteed final model. Keep recognized words unchanged through attribution. Repair source omissions and segmentation/recovery defects before training.
architecture.speakers: Retain current Native8 as a measured baseline. Evaluate an implementable bounded-memory whole-recording identity solution against the returning-speaker failure; old all-in-memory global pipeline is rejected for unchanged rerun.
architecture.minutes: Use the existing product generation path with source time references. Check against original audio, including decisions, owners, dates, amounts and negation; uncertain source content remains unresolved.
architecture.runtime: One explicit candidate model/runtime bundle with draft/refining/final/incomplete states, cancellation, resume, errors and versions. PC, phone and actual card capabilities measured separately.
architecture.privacy: Local-first. No silent cloud fallback or private-recording upload. Any existing explicitly selected network enhancement is separately qualified and cannot stand in for offline quality.

englishMetricHandling: Report English WER and critical bilingual facts separately; freeze the English acceptance definition in the quality implementation before qualification. Do not silently reuse Chinese CER as English WER or use4-second switching as full-meeting acceptance.
performanceHandling: InitialRTF<=1 remains a development gate. Final product waiting targets must be frozen for the actual supported PC/phone and measured for cold load, live lag and post-stop finalization; no invented P95 from fewer than20 valid samples.
executionRules: One product batch is a complete usable user result; scripts, commits and documents are evidence, not delivered functionality.
Reuse immutable completed inference and unaffected product evidence. No same-condition failed long reruns.
Use mature fixed components first. Training is conditional on a reproducible residual and clean training/validation separation; never required just to demonstrate activity.
A rejected candidate ends that candidate only. Continue other authorized work toward the original product outcome without waiting for repeated continue requests.
A second independent method is justified only to resolve a defined quality or resource gap; no growing model roster or threshold search.
Keep one neural inference family at a time, originalCPU5%/private2GiB/actual Windows low-RAM guards for present local work. No other-app termination or system protection changes.
Actual device participation uses the original shared operator prompt only when human action is necessary; prepare background work first.

nextBatch.userVisibleGoal: One supported meeting job can progress from incoming audio or an offline file to a recoverable final transcript and source-linked minutes through the existing product contract.
nextBatch.modelWork: First unify candidate backend lifecycle and bilingual input/output; reuse completed Qwen/alignment inputs for integration. In the same batch address speaker finalization memory failure/identity persistence and source-word losses with bounded implementation checks.
nextBatch.frontendDependency: Existing frontend task integrates/reviews the versioned candidate via shared backlog; no unsolicited messages, parallel product task tree or takeover of its working files.
nextBatch.noPrematureShipping: Do not change the installed default to an unqualified research candidate. Internal executable checkpoint and sellable release have separate states.
